note: Read 2026-10-13 from bergerbullets.com only (robots.txt: Disallow empty). Empty on purpose: construction of hunting/varmint lines (pages name only the J4 copper jacket, never the core metal); tip shape of all non-OTM lines (no hollow point/open tip stated; LRHT only mentions MRT meplat). 300 Norma Mag 215 gr page sits in the OTM Tactical line and names a "215gr Hybrid" bullet.
